name: BIG-Bench Extra Hard
description: BIG-Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) is a benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on more challenging reasoning tasks by replacing each task in BIG-Bench Hard with a novel, significantly more difficult task probing similar reasoning capabilities.
typical_sota_score: ~45% (best reasoning models as of early 2026; best general-purpose ~10–15%)
reputation: A newer, harder follow-up to BIG-Bench Hard that is intended to probe reasoning more deeply, but it has not yet reached the same level of broad community adoption as BIG-Bench Hard.
notes: Addresses saturation of BIG-Bench Hard by introducing more difficult tasks; shows substantial room for improvement in LLM reasoning.
